scope.goal: Validate dynamic attachment and observable local-fixture overhead.
scope.rationale: Feature scope; not all HyperHub protocols or production workload distributions.

workloads.goal: Approved attach, detach, reattach and fault recovery for local process trees.

items.goal: Approved attach, detach, reattach and fault recovery for local process trees.

items.description: Consumed/completion history must be rooted in trusted accepted-operation state; an ordinary writable ledger key snapshot cannot alone authorize continuation.
Runtime envelope/API authority cannot derive the administrator signing key or claim implicit external run ownership.
Refuse configured TLS/SSH interception unsupported by existing contexts without weakening configuration.
API-only cold startup stays Unenrolled for external lifecycle mutation while ordinary Serve/policy/run startup remains usable.
Core verification uses an enrolled in-memory approval key; ordinary verifier-file replacement cannot register or change the root.
Reject future, exactly expired and expired grants; consume each nonce once for its OS claimant.
Linux Host OS peer authentication rejects wrong server PID before credentials/proofs are sent.
Windows named-pipe OS peer authentication rejects wrong server PID before credentials/proofs are sent.
Every Host pins its initial approval root; no command or ordinary file may lazily choose a different first root.
Linux Gum attach and detach proposals have no policy side effects before approval.
Linux ptrace attach and detach proposals have no policy side effects before approval.
Windows Gum attach and detach proposals have no policy side effects before approval.
Password changes require contiguous instance/generation-bound old-key-signed rotation records; missing/reordered/backward or untrusted chains never replace a pinned root.
Password/config-generation changes immediately invalidate old signers, preserve consumed audit and retain encrypted recovery readability.
Reject altered process identity, scope, policy, capabilities, executor, Bootstrap, Host identity and recovery bindings.

A Draining/resident slot that becomes terminal during human review receives fresh request/attachment/session/token epochs without changing target/scope/backend/policy or repeating approval; clients follow the actual returned id.
First real administrator approve completes challenge-bound registration via authenticated trusted CLI code, then the exact original request without another password prompt.
Linux Gum preserves PID/cwd/stdio/env, explicit exec/spawn environment and original exit status.
Linux Gum preserves existing/new TCP payload, blocked read result and preopened/nonblocking socket flags.
Linux Gum target with controlling PTY preserves termios and foreground terminal identity.
Linux ptrace preserves PID/cwd/stdio/env, explicit exec/spawn environment and original exit status.
Linux ptrace preserves existing/new TCP payload, blocked read result and preopened/nonblocking socket flags.
Linux ptrace target with controlling PTY preserves termios and foreground terminal identity.
After authenticated Host READY, failed keeper creation/claim/control I/O never kills the target; retire only the exact created helper, preserve native recovery context and truthful owner.
Each backend run launcher keeps waiting after detach and returns original root status independently of persistent manager lifetime.
Windows Gum preserves PID/cwd/stdio/env and original exit status.
Windows Gum preserves existing/new TCP payload and blocked original ReadFile result.
Native Windows target terminal modes, foreground console and keyboard semantics survive lifecycle changes; an approval ConPTY alone is insufficient.
Only exact physical-absence marker/pending phases and an accepted signed consumed operation can revoke session; rotation and lost ACK preserve idempotent completion.
Linux Gum detach preserves an outstanding original blocked read and nonblocking flags.
Independent module/callback/cache evidence distinguishes Linux Gum resident compatibility from proven unload.
Linux ptrace detach preserves an outstanding original blocked read and nonblocking flags.
Independent OS TracerPid checks prove every covered live member is untraced before public Detached.
Windows Gum remains loaded during blocked ReadFile and retained modified Schannel credential; unload only after explicit release.
Independent native module enumeration proves all eligible live members are unloaded before public Detached; token/session revocation completes.
ObservedExternal cached addresses on linux-gum use the unchanged original native connect after Detach and match a genuine unmanaged same-sockaddr baseline, with no old gateway policy.
Actual HyperHub-issued aliases on linux-gum preserve their hostname and use the target SDK original resolver/connect after Detach, without Core/Socks dependency.
Allocate/observe another destination on linux-gum and prove an application-cached old alias is never reassigned across detach epochs or DNS TTL expiry.
ObservedExternal cached addresses on linux-ptrace use the unchanged original native connect after Detach and match a genuine unmanaged same-sockaddr baseline, with no old gateway policy.
Actual HyperHub-issued aliases on linux-ptrace preserve their hostname and use the target SDK original resolver/connect after Detach, without Core/Socks dependency.
Allocate/observe another destination on linux-ptrace and prove an application-cached old alias is never reassigned across detach epochs or DNS TTL expiry.
Cache a real HyperHub FAKE-IP before detach, connect through that exact cached alias after detach/reattach, and prove an additional destination never reuses it.
Within linux-gum-attach compare validated local fixed-window work with native and same-backend run baselines; save raw samples and exact valid counts/window elapsed for latency and throughput.
Within linux-gum-run compare validated local fixed-window work with native and same-backend run baselines; save raw samples and exact valid counts/window elapsed for latency and throughput.
Within linux-ptrace-attach compare validated local fixed-window work with native and same-backend run baselines; save raw samples and exact valid counts/window elapsed for latency and throughput.
Within linux-ptrace-run compare validated local fixed-window work with native and same-backend run baselines; save raw samples and exact valid counts/window elapsed for latency and throughput.
Within windows-gum-attach-latency preserve 50 validated snapshot command latency samples and phase labels; this is not the Linux mixed 64-command workload.
Measure actual fixed-window elapsed and 50 validated same-fixture snapshot commands on windows-gum-attach; report commands/s separately from Linux mixed-command throughput.
Within windows-gum-run-latency preserve 50 validated snapshot command latency samples and phase labels; this is not the Linux mixed 64-command workload.
Measure actual fixed-window elapsed and 50 validated same-fixture snapshot commands on windows-gum-run; report commands/s separately from Linux mixed-command throughput.

After completed revocation plus ACK loss and manager death, fresh approved Detach may perform exact historical-receipt cleanup without creating members; wrong identity/token/target and Attach are denied.
After original root and manager exit, approve cleanup by id and reconnect/detach exact live Gum descendants without injection.
After original root and manager exit, approve cleanup by id and detach live ptrace descendants without requiring dead-root inspection.
After original root and manager exit, approve cleanup by id and detach exact live Windows descendants.
After ptrace manager loss with unproven virtual descriptor state, refuse unsafe recovery explicitly, keep target alive and do not silently seize or claim protection.
Kill only the disposable Gum manager, prove target/allowed traffic survives; fresh approval reconnects exact compatible Host with no new injection.
Kill only the disposable authenticated ptrace manager, prove target survives and enforcement loss is truthful; fresh approval safely reseizes with no duplicate tracer.
Kill only the authenticated disposable Windows manager; fresh approval reconnects exact resident Host and one native module.
Restart/lose Serve during active Gum tree; cached policy, allowed streams and subsequent approved lifecycle remain valid.
Restart/lose Serve during active ptrace tree; cached policy, allowed streams and subsequent approved lifecycle remain valid.
Restart/lose Serve during active Windows tree; cached policy, allowed streams and subsequent approved lifecycle remain valid.
Tighten a real deny policy while detached; the first covered operation after fresh approved reactivation must use the new policy synchronously.
Linux explicit-tag installer preserves stable sentinel and shortcut and uses development version directory.
Built prerelease CLI selects private default HOME/Skill and manual updates without touching stable paths.
Exact commit native platform CI and full soak pass; published prerelease is not latest; download all six artifacts and verify manifest/version/architecture/SHA and real operations.
Windows explicit-tag installer preserves stable executable, shortcut and user PATH.
Complete >=100 successful cycles AND >=7200 seconds of target mixed activity after readiness on linux-gum; after warmup track native modules, threads and FDs/handles without continued growth.
Complete >=100 successful cycles AND >=7200 seconds of target mixed activity after readiness on linux-ptrace; after warmup track native modules, threads and FDs/handles without continued growth.
Complete >=100 successful cycles AND >=7200 seconds of target mixed activity after readiness on windows-gum; after warmup track native modules, threads and FDs/handles without continued growth.
fork/clone/rebuild descendants preserve the accepted detach cutoff and cannot replay an older/equal-time Attach to reactivate policy.
Linux Gum process: deny target, permit separate existing/future descendants.
Linux Gum tree: deny root and preexisting/fork/exec descendants.
Linux ptrace process: deny target, permit separate existing/future descendants.
Linux ptrace tree: deny root and preexisting/fork/exec descendants.
Owned Linux Gum run returns root exit 37 promptly while its survivor remains managed and can be detached.
Owned Linux ptrace run returns root exit 37 promptly while its survivor remains managed and can be detached.
Windows keeper preserves descendant enforcement and detach after original root exit.
Already running target threads and concurrent thread creation cannot escape at attach/detach boundaries on every backend.
Measure children alive or in-flight across the actual Windows commit boundary; no reset may hide post-commit allowed work.
Hold a deterministic existing child alive before Windows attach; it must be denied after tree commit.
Windows approved tree denies post-commit child exec and at least ten fresh native child reads.
Native Windows lifecycle and approved tree cover MSYS/Cygwin fork/clone shared-memory rebuild and metadata/Host identity rebinding; native Rust exec fixtures do not cover this ABI boundary.

limitations: DRAFT REVIEW SNAPSHOT ONLY: source is still changing. The digest binds this manifest snapshot, not a final release/source freeze; refresh and independently review changed references before actual benchmark execution.
No run.json is synthesized. Existing r1/r2/r3 diagnostic evidence predates this model and remains diagnostic, including known failures; no record is promoted to frozen execution or valid measurement.

All nine original obligations and all six backend/origin combinations remain required. Added explicit sub-boundaries prevent one implemented path from completing unrelated platform or safety boundaries.

Native Windows, aarch64 hardware attachment, 100cycle/two-hour backend soaks and exact-commit release CI/publication remain separate execution gates; structural checker success is not native execution.

Windows future-child stress resets counters after Active and does not independently prove a deterministic preexisting child or allowed/denied outcomes exactly across commit. Those two native boundaries remain planned.

Linux fixed window is32 snapshot/socket pairs=64 commands; Windows fixed window is50 snapshots. Both collectors now have elapsed timing, but cross-invocation same-backend run comparison protocol remains planned on Windows; latency-only implemented mappings do not complete throughput comparison obligations.

Current resource drivers now have post-readiness clocks, concrete loop minima, mixed-work assertions and native resource plateaus. Their source implementation is bound in C-soak cases; no100cycle/7200second execution or valid measurement is declared. Windows bounded slack is the explicit code contract (+8 handles/+1 thread), distinct from Linux exact post-warmup FD/thread/map counts.
Windows MSYS/Cygwin fork/clone lifecycle is an explicit planned boundary. Native Rust CreateProcess/exec and native console fixtures cannot satisfy it.

Approval root anchoring is still a read-only interface design. Core/Host pinned roots, API-only cold Unenrolled state, trusted first enrollment, signed rotation chain and accepted-history integrity remain planned release gates. Existing crypto tests against a mutable verifier are not proof of those properties.

ObservedExternal and HyperHub-issued addresses require separate native-equivalence oracles. Earlier no-native-route external FAKE fixture assertions were invalid; they remain raw diagnostics, not confirmed product defects or fixed coverage. Revised source-provenance cases are planned until reviewed.

Windows now holds a deterministic preexisting child and retains all timed busy-child events. Strict post-published-Active events after a1ms clock guard are asserted; exact commit/ambiguous time-window scheduling still has a distinct planned boundary.

Hashes and declarations do not prove semantic completeness, oracle truth, execution authenticity, or statistical validity.
